CON DIO Communications is a two-way radio specialist based in Booysens, Pretoria, supplying, installing, programming, servicing and repairing mobile and base-station radios from major brands. The business also rents out radio equipment and works across analogue, digital and trunking radio-communication systems, covering everything from individual handsets to multi-site networks.

Trading under the Auto-Com communications banner, the business extends into radio-communication consulting, helping clients plan and specify the right equipment and coverage for their operations, and offers turnkey communication solutions that bundle hardware, programming and installation into a single project. It operates from 625 Attie Street, Booysens, Pretoria, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 17:00, making it a practical call-in point for businesses, security firms and other operators that depend on reliable two-way radio communication.

Core Digital Printers is a digital and commercial printing business based in Silvertondale, Pretoria, producing business cards, posters, signage and a wide range of custom-printed material for its clients. Alongside printing, the business offers in-house graphic design, so customers can have artwork prepared and finished under one roof rather than sourcing design work elsewhere, and it also stocks screen-printing supplies for customers running their own print jobs.

The combination of design, digital printing and screen-printing supplies gives the business a broader offering than a straightforward print shop, suiting small businesses, event organisers and individuals who need anything from a short run of business cards to larger signage and poster orders. Core Digital Printers trades from 116 Mosaic Road, Silvertondale, Pretoria 0184, serving customers from the surrounding Jan Niemand Park and Silvertondale area who need quick-turnaround commercial printing.

Crazy Plastics Centurion is a branch of the Crazy Plastics discount homeware chain, trading from Shop 7 and 8 at Raslouw Lifestyle Centre, 18 Hendrik Verwoerd Drive, Celtisdal, Centurion. The store stocks an affordable range of household, storage, kitchen, bathroom, cleaning, office, catering and general plastic products, along with outdoor and garden items, giving shoppers a wide selection of everyday plastic ware under one roof.

As part of a chain with branches around the country, the Centurion store benefits from buying power that keeps prices low on practical, everyday items for the home and garden. It serves households, families and small businesses in Celtisdal and the surrounding Centurion area, and is open Monday to Friday from 08:30 to 18:00, Saturdays from 08:30 to 16:30 and Sundays from 09:00 to 15:00.

Crazy Plastics Express Madelief is a branch of the Crazy Plastics chain in Madelief Mall, Dorandia, Pretoria. Its store page says the branch serves customers across Pretoria, Akasia, Soshanguve, Pyramid, Roodeplaat, Centurion, Ga-Rankuwa and several other nearby areas. The store sells household and cleaning products, storage and organisation items, kitchenware, catering supplies and confectionery.

Hours listed on the page are Monday to Friday 09:00 to 18:00, Saturday 08:00 to 17:00 and Sunday 09:00 to 14:00. The page notes that delivery from this branch is not yet available, and it offers a notification for when the store goes online. The chain's About Us information describes a business that began as a plastics retailer and has grown into a destination for storage, cleaning, kitchenware and catering products, with an emphasis on affordable everyday household supplies for families and businesses.

CrisisOnCall is a private 24/7 emergency helpline and crisis management service based in Monument Park, Pretoria. Its Crisis Connect service lets people send an SMS to the emergency number, after which an agent calls back; for the hearing impaired, the service sends an SMS instead.

Members register for speed-dial access to the National Call Center, and an agent contacts them to help in a crisis. The company also offers a trip monitoring service for long-distance road travel, in which the call centre checks in on the driver at set intervals within South Africa's borders.

Its mobile app includes a panic button for quick access to emergency support, and a Protect Me feature sends security services to the member's location when activated. Members can also call the centre for professional advice on health and other emergencies, with no airtime needed for the speed-dial service. Membership plans are offered for families, seniors, scholars, employees and truck drivers, and the company's terms and conditions apply.

CURO DATA SOLUTIONS, based in The Willows, Pretoria, provides material master data cleansing, consultancy and governance solutions, delivered through a combination of software and services. The company explains that the materials master forms the foundation of inventory, purchasing and maintenance management processes and systems, and its work is aimed at asset-intensive organisations that want to reduce costs and improve operational effectiveness. Its product line includes MRO Solutions and CuroCat Software for maintenance, repair and operations data.

According to its website, the company is a small, customer-centric organisation in Gauteng that has processed thousands of master data records for clients in multiple industries. It states that its growth rests on professionalism, attention to detail and a commitment to quality work, and that the team adapts quickly as client needs change. Prospective clients can schedule a meeting through the website.

Cycad World of Innovations is a specialist cycad nursery in Pretoria, Gauteng, which says it has been in existence for about 13 and a half years. The nursery holds around 65,000 cycads made up of 60 different African species, ranging from very scarce and exclusive plants to more common ones.

The business says it can provide the permits needed to import and export cycads to national and international destinations, as permitted under CITES. It states that all its cycads are cultivated under strict CITES 1 conditions and supervision.

The business sells plants and runs auctions, and its website lists cycad books, care products and pesticides, and new arrivals. It also runs cycad workshops and an academy covering cycad care and identification, as well as a cycad identification project. Its website says the owner's goal was to grow cycads from seed and supply every species from seedlings to mature plants.

Dante Personnel Recruitment is a recruitment consultancy operating from Building 76, Suite 14, Tijger Valley Office Park on Silverlakes Road, Silverlakes. The consultancy places candidates on a permanent, contract and temporary basis, and also handles disability placements, project recruitment and vendor-on-site recruitment, where consultants work embedded within a client's own operations to manage ongoing staffing needs.

Its response management service helps employers handle large volumes of applications for bulk or high-turnover roles. The consultancy recruits across a range of sectors, including administration, finance, engineering, mining, manufacturing and logistics, giving it reach across both office-based and industrial hiring needs. Founded in 1996 and employing between 11 and 50 staff, Dante Personnel Recruitment serves employers across these industries from its Tijger Valley office in Silverlakes, Pretoria.

Debonairs Pizza Gezina is a branch of the Debonairs Pizza chain, trading from Shop 41 at Gezina Galleries, 569 Frederika Street, Gezina, Pretoria. The outlet offers the chain's full pizza line-up, including the popular Triple-Decker range and the budget-friendly Real Deal range, alongside additional pizza varieties and meal options such as combos and side orders.

Orders can be placed for takeaway, in-store collection or home delivery, giving customers in Gezina and the surrounding area a convenient option for a quick meal or a family order. As part of a well-known South African pizza franchise, the Gezina branch draws on the brand's established menu and recipes while serving its own local customers from within the Gezina Galleries shopping centre, making it a regular stop for residents and nearby workers alike.

Debonairs Pizza Philip Nel Park is a branch of the Debonairs Pizza chain, located on the corner of Trans Oranje and Morkel East Streets in Philip Nel Park, Pretoria. Customers can order for collection, takeaway or delivery, making the branch a convenient option for households and workers in Philip Nel Park and the surrounding suburbs. As part of a long-running national pizza franchise, the branch combines a familiar, tested menu with everyday local trading, and is open Monday to Saturday from 10:00 to 22:00 and Sunday from 10:00 to 21:00.

DeltaERP is an enterprise resource planning platform provided by DataSaint (Pty) Ltd from offices at 90 Kingbolt Crescent, Wapadrand Office Park, Block A, Pretoria. The platform is built as a configurable business-management solution, with modules that can be adapted to different business functions rather than a single fixed package, allowing it to be set up around the way a particular company already works.

Its module range covers core business functions such as financial management and accounts payable, giving finance teams a system for tracking transactions and payments alongside other operational data. DataSaint has operated since 1985, giving the DeltaERP platform a long-established base of business and systems experience behind it. The Wapadrand office serves as the base for supporting and implementing the platform for client businesses in and around Pretoria.

The firm describes itself as a group of multi-skilled professionals who bring together design, planning and technical expertise, and its homepage metadata calls it a group of award-winning architects and development planners. Dikoloi is an automotive workshop in East Lynne, Pretoria, specialising in gearbox and transmission work for cars, 4x4s and trucks. Its services include gearbox repairs, differential diagnostics, maintenance and rebuilds, including custom modifications, transfer case repairs and maintenance, and clutch repairs.

The website describes its approach as emphasising preventative care and quality, with the aim of keeping vehicles reliable. It states that switching between two-wheel and four-wheel drive is central to performance in demanding conditions, which is why transfer case work matters. The business also lists Gearmax parts, with a stockists section on its site, and points customers to the Gearmax website for further product information.

The firm's listed services include rehabilitating businesses in financial distress, conducting viability assessments, and improving business efficiency and profitability. It also offers mentoring to SMMEs, designs and presents business skills training programmes, conducts skills assessment assignments, and carries out impact evaluations of training programmes. The website presents these as separate service areas, covering the full cycle from assessing a business's viability to training and measuring the impact of that training.

Its cloud and modern work offering covers Microsoft 365, Azure, migrations, infrastructure modernisation and secure collaboration. Its cybersecurity work covers identity, endpoint protection, vulnerability management, attack simulation, backup, recovery and security architecture. The company also provides custom software engineering and a product it calls Castle OS, which it describes as a way to govern consequential digital transactions.

On the hardware side it supplies laptops and desktops, servers and storage, networking equipment and monitors, with bulk business procurement, configuration and deployment, and warranty coordination. It describes its delivery as Microsoft-aligned.

Repair work covers dish realignment after storms or wind, LNB replacement where the part is cracked or rusted, cable faults, decoders that will not power on, problems with splitters or signal boosters, and software issues on older decoders. Based in Centurion and serving clients from the surrounding Brooklands and Reeds area, the practice is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00, offering a single point of contact for family, civil, commercial and criminal legal needs.

The range includes bacon, ribs, chops and wors, along with other pork cuts and processed products, giving customers a dedicated pork specialist rather than a general butchery counter.

The store runs bulk-buy promotions alongside everyday retail sales, serving individual shoppers and families stocking up for a braai as well as bulk buyers such as businesses, spaza shops and caterers who need pork products in larger quantities. Eskort Store Centurion is open Monday to Friday from 09:00 to 17:00, Saturday from 08:00 to 16:00 and Sunday from 09:00 to 13:00, giving both everyday and bulk customers several days a week to shop.

Eurosure Insurance Consultants CC is a short-term insurance broker based in Garsfontein Office Park, Pretoria, established in 1998. Its personal insurance range includes named-peril cover and all-risk cover. Its liability range covers public liability, professional indemnity and cyber insurance. Its business insurance range covers business and commercial cover, contractors' all-risk, hospitality and engineering insurance.

The company describes its service as personalised, with affordable rates and plans for each client, and says it aims to treat each individual client with respect and compassion. Its website also publishes terms and conditions, a privacy policy and compliance policies.
